title: metrosp

title: Getting Started
text: metrosp package provides access Metro de São Paulo public transportation data. Since data updated regularly datasets rather compact, package distributes data “lazy” format. means data comes prepackaged called directly, without needing download import raw data. four main datasets: passengers_entrance: daily passengers entering metro system passengers_transported: daily passengers transported metro system station_averages: daily average passengers per station station_daily: daily passengers per station convenience, metrosp also provides information stations lines metro system (lines, stations, metro_lines). lines dataset spatial dataset requires sf package work properly. Finally, package also provides named vector colors line metro system (metro_colors). Using datasets straightforward, just call dataset name. datasets returned tibble using dplyr package recommended.

title: Getting Started
text: tutorial briefly introduce main datasets use making simple visualizations data. better replicate visualization, use ggplot2 package custom theme . passengers_entrance passengers_transported datasets monthly passengers entering transported metro system. former daily count passengers entering metro system, latter daily count passengers transported metro system. data aggregated metrics: max: maximum number passengers (daily peak) mdu: average number passengers business days mdo: average number passengers Sundays msa: average number passengers Saturdays total: total number passengers dataset identified month (date), line (line_number, line_name), metric (metric_abb, metric). data tidy format. Note special line defined aggregate total METRÔ system (line_name = "METRO System" line_num = 99). uses, ’s best filter line. plot shows total monthly passenger entrances metro line. Note line-5 series interrupted since ownership line transferred ViaMobilidade 2018.  dataset identified month (date), line (line_number, line_name), metric (metric_abb, metric). data tidy format. columns passengers_entrance thousands passengers. Also, dataset currently includes data METRÔ operated system. future, dataset may expanded include lines 4 5. Note special line defined aggregate total METRÔ system (line_name = "METRO System" line_num = 99). uses, ’s best filter line. plot shows daily average (business days) passenger transported metro line.  dataset identified month (date), line (line_number, line_name), station (station_name). value column available avg_passenger, daily average (business days) passengers entering station. plot shows daily average (business days) passengers entering station line 4. Note temporal range data unequal across stations, since inaugurated time.  dataset identified day (date), line (line_number, line_name), station (station_name). value column available passengers, daily number passengers entering station. Additionally, column station_code contains three letter abbreviations stations, METRÔ operated lines. plot shows trend daily passengers entering station line 4 2023.
